title: stachys rugosa var. linearis
intro: Stachys rugosa var. linearis, commonly known as Korean wormwood, is a variety of the Stachys rugosa plant species, which belongs to the mint family. It has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, inflammation, and digestive issues. The plant is rich in bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents in Stachys rugosa var. linearis have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as reducing fever, relieving pain, and promoting wound healing, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine.
